ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark surface with approximately 5-10% high-intensity white pixel coverage concentrated in localized clusters and linear marks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity clusters are localized at the distal tips of both lobes; sparse punctate white spots and linear streaks are distributed across the dark-grey background of both ventral surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 60 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 15% of the visible lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge boundary; more pronounced irregular indentations visible on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve extending from the median notch towards the distal tips with a slight upward flare at the outer margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-contrast white pixel groupings at both distal tips (barnacle colonization); isolated circular white rings visible on the central area of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) of varying lengths and orientations across both lobes; most prominent is a vertical streak on the central-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified barnacle clusters at the tips and numerous healed linear scars across the fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced accumulation of sessile barnacles at the extreme lateral margins of the fluke.
